title: ENSA, and leading General Huebner's orchestra
summary: Marian was on loan from ENSA; he became the general's orchestra leader and flew to Paris to see her.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Now was she with the USO Command Shows, or Camp shows that we in?

Yes. She was on lend from the British ENSA which is the equivalent of our USO. She was transferred over. They needed piano players who could play accordian and so on and so forth. She could do anything on those things.

So that was it, we got married and went there and came back and then my outfit went all the way up to (Toaz?) in Czechoslovakia and I became General HüBNER personal orchestra leader and played for President (Benish?) up there in Czechoslovakia. And used to fly back and forth to Paris and see Marian and back and forth.
And the General would see that you had a flight, huh? (LAUGHTER).

Yes, that's right. I used to say to the General (Hübner), I'd say General, my corfnet needs repairing and there's only one place to get it fixed and that's in Paris General. You know, he said, I understand Mac, I understand. (LAUGHTER). He was marvellous to me. I'd go to Paris and back.
